captions.detailed: This 3D model is a specialized sign holder designed to clamp onto a cylindrical bar, such as a clothing rack. The top section features a wide, horizontal T-shaped platform with integrated slots on both ends to securely slide and hold a flat sign. The lower section consists of a vertical bracket with a large, curved C-clamp opening tailored to wrap around a 1-inch diameter pipe, complete with structural cutouts to allow for easy snap-on mounting.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric OpenSCAD script for a sign holder that clips onto a clothing rack bar. The design should include adjustable parameters for the bar diameter, sign thickness, sign holder depth, and wall thickness to ensure a secure fit.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a boolean difference operation between a solid base and several cutout primitives. The main body is formed by unioning two central cubes: a wide top block for the sign channel and a vertical column for the clamp structure. Cutouts are made using cylinders rotated 90 degrees on the X-axis for the main horizontal bar, combined with hull operations to create an angled entry path, and custom cubes to define the precise sliding sign slot.
